beats.say: A razor that never needs a new handle. And you keep paying forever.
Buy the razor alone - just the handle.
Buy the razor plus a starter pack of blades - the usual bundle.
Buy the razor, a starter pack, and a monthly blade subscription - the premium promise.
But it does a job - it forces you to buy blades forever.
Each razor sale creates a customer who must replenish blades.
In 1904 the blade count exceeds razors by 32,764, proving repeat purchases.
The more handles you sell, the more blade revenue streams flow.
You see it everywhere - a coffee shop gives a free mug with a drink, then sells refill packs.
A streaming service offers a cheap app, then a pricey ad-free tier that includes monthly content drops.
The refill or subscription feels like a smart upgrade because you already own the base.
Spot the recurring consumable and count the hidden cost. Follow for more.
